Metadata.Title: Bloodborne
Metadata.Name: Sprint Fix (High FPS)
Metadata.Note: Fixes sprint dropping to half speed above ~147 FPS (and at random moments above ~90 FPS). Use together with Uncap FPS++ or 90 FPS++. The game's wall detector measured distance per frame (a 30 FPS rule); this makes it measure speed instead.
Metadata.Author: yogesh1239
